description: Source code implementing reflog walking and management functions for a Git repository, including reading, freeing, and iterating over reflog entries.

classes.name: complete_reflogs
classes.description: Structure representing a collection of reflog entries for a specific reference.

classes.name: reflog_info
classes.description: Structure holding individual reflog entry details such as object IDs, email, timestamp, message.

classes.name: commit_reflog
classes.description: Structure representing a specific reflog within a reference, including recno and selector type.

classes.name: reflog_walk_info
classes.description: Structure maintaining state for walking through reflog entries, including list of commit_reflog objects.

methods.name: read_one_reflog
methods.description: Callback to read a single reflog entry and store it in the complete_reflogs structure.

methods.name: free_complete_reflog
methods.description: Function to free memory allocated for a complete_reflogs structure.

methods.name: complete_reflogs_clear
methods.description: Callback to clear a complete_reflogs structure.

methods.name: read_complete_reflog
methods.description: Reads all reflog entries for a given reference, attempting multiple ref paths.

methods.name: get_reflog_recno_by_time
methods.description: Finds the reflog record number closest to a given timestamp.

methods.name: reflog_walk_info_release
methods.description: Releases memory associated with a reflog_walk_info structure.

methods.name: add_reflog_for_walk
methods.description: Adds a reflog entry for a specific commit and reference name to the walk context.

methods.name: get_reflog_selector
methods.description: Generates a string representing the reflog entry's reference and date.

methods.name: get_reflog_message
methods.description: Retrieves the message associated with the current reflog entry.

methods.name: get_reflog_ident
methods.description: Returns the email identifier of the current reflog entry.

methods.name: get_reflog_timestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the current reflog entry.

methods.name: show_reflog_message
methods.description: Displays the reflog message, optionally in a one-line format.

methods.name: reflog_walk_empty
methods.description: Checks if the reflog walk context has no entries.

methods.name: next_reflog_commit
methods.description: Retrieves the next commit object from a reflog entry.

methods.name: log_timestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of a reflog entry.

methods.name: next_reflog_entry
methods.description: Retrieves the next commit in order from the reflog walk context.
